fato_historico: 1985: A Dassault Falcon 50 and a Piper PA-28 Cherokee collide in mid-air over Fairview, New Jersey, killing six people and injuring eight.

It is a good time to radiate warmth and ensure your spirit remains anchored in love, embracing the beauty of every fleeting moment that comes your way today.
frase_do_dia: Cherish the light within you, for it guides your journey through the open skies.
